# Women In Tools

ATG is a great place for women to build a dynamic career.  With professional development and
opportunities to grow, the potential is a click away.

[Learn More][63]
 
 

# Join Our Team

ATG is a lean, innovative and inclusive team where every idea counts. Your creativity, passion and
know-how can accelerate our success. Join us to build the career you’ve always wanted.

[Learn More][64]
 
 

# Electronics

We make the tools needed to support the design, testing, manufacturing and repair of the latest
electronics innovations -- from smart phones and tablets to video game consoles and e-readers.

[Learn More][65]
 
 

# Construction / DIY

We provide contractors with durable and dependable tools for material handling, framing, surveying,
inspecting, and many build/rebuild tasks.

[Learn More][66]
 
 

# Motor Vehicle Industry

We provide the fastening solutions global motor vehicle manufacturers need to ensure superior
quality production.

[Learn More][67]
 
 

# Industrial

With a reputation dating back more than 100 years, we provide tools and equipment for preventative
machine maintenance, production, and parts assembly at the most demanding industrial facilities and
production and parts assembly at manufacturing plants around the globe.

[Learn More][68]
 
 

# Vehicle Service

We offer a wide array of professional hand and power tools to the global service industry. In this
market that relies largely on manual labor, we know that time is money.

[Learn More][69]
 
 

# Aerospace

Built with the stringent standards of the aerospace technician in mind, our tools improve
productivity and ensure strength and precision during the assembly process.

[Learn More][70]
 

# ATG’s Master Brands

Apex Tool Group manufactures leading hand and power tool brands around the world.

# Kurtz Ersa - GLOBAL. AHEAD. SUSTAINABLE.

We are a globally active mechanical engineering company based in Spessart, Germany, founded in 1779
and owner-managed in the seventh generation. As a technology and market leader in the fields of
electronics production equipment, moulding machines and automation, we optimize our customers'
manufacturing processes. Thanks to our global footprint, we realize innovative solutions worldwide
with only one goal in mind: the highest quality for our customers! We are an attractive employer in
the region and offer our employees a wide range of training opportunities through our in-house
academy. For us, sustainability not only means protecting the environment, but also long-term
partnerships with our business partners and a high level of reliability in what we do every day. For
our 250th anniversary in 2029, we are aiming to be CO2-neutral.*

# Kurtz Ersa - GLOBAL. AHEAD. SUSTAINABLE.

We are a globally active mechanical engineering company based in Spessart, Germany, founded in 1779
and owner-managed in the seventh generation. As a technology and market leader in the fields of
electronics production equipment, moulding machines and automation, we optimize our customers'
manufacturing processes. Thanks to our global footprint, we realize innovative solutions worldwide
with only one goal in mind: the highest quality for our customers! We are an attractive employer in
the region and offer our employees a wide range of training opportunities through our in-house
academy. For us, sustainability not only means protecting the environment, but also long-term
partnerships with our business partners and a high level of reliability in what we do every day. For
our 250th anniversary in 2029, we are aiming to be CO2-neutral.*

# Custom Coating & Laminating for
# Specialty Material Development

Made-to-order roll-to-roll manufacturing for custom coated and laminated materials — with
confidentiality, flexibility, and technical expertise.

[Request a Quote][137]
[Contact Us][138]

## What We Make

Engineered materials built to perform — from concept to production scale.

### Specialty Papers

Custom-coated and laminated papers engineered for strength, barrier performance, printability, and
functional use.

### Packaging Materials

High-performance substrates for flexible packaging, food packaging, and converting applications.

### Eco-Friendly & Sustainable Solutions

Water-based coatings, recyclable structures, and innovative materials developed to meet
sustainability goals.

[paper coating and laminations]

## Why Customers Work With Us

#### Made-to-Order Manufacturing

Every project is custom. We develop and produce materials to meet your exact performance
requirements.

#### Flexible Production & Raw Material Options

We work with a wide range of papers, films, met/pet, adhesives, and coatings — giving you more
design freedom.

#### Confidential Innovation

We partner with customers to develop new, proprietary, and sustainable materials under strict
confidentiality.

#### Large-Scale Roll-to-Roll Capability

Industrial-scale coating and laminating lines deliver consistent results from pilot runs to full
production.

#### Quality Systems You Can Trust

ISO-based processes, traceability, and rigorous testing ensure repeatable performance.

## Our Core Services

Precision manufacturing across coating, laminating, and toll services.

### Custom Coating

Water-based, adhesive, barrier, and specialty coatings applied with precision.

### Custom Laminating

Paper-to-paper, paper-to-film, and film-to-foil laminations for packaging and industrial
applications.

### Toll Manufacturing

Outsourced coating and laminating capacity for converters, printers, and material developers.

## Let’s Build Your Next Specialty Material

Whether you’re developing a new material, improving an existing product, or scaling production,
our technical team is ready to help.

# Technitool, Inc.

Since our beginning in 1975, our philosophy has been to build a quality product. We feel that our
name is our reputation. In an industry as tightly knit as plastics, you must consistently build an
excellent quality mold to continue to grow as we have.

We are very proud of the fact that over the decades we have been in business, we have retained many
of the customers that we've had since the beginning.

A business is more than just steel and design, it's people. We have built our company on the theory
that you should treat people as you would like to be treated, and this has worked very well for us.

We believe that our company is more service than manufacturing. Technitool is small enough to know
you, but large enough to provide excellent service.

When producing a quality mold, people are the key, and we have the key people. We listen and we
understand what it means when you say that time to market is critical. We will guide you in choosing
the molding process and material for maximum quality and value. We can help solve problems by
finding new and better ways of molding plastic parts. Responding to your needs in a timely fashion
is what the expert staff at Technitool does best.

## **Your Vision?**
## Our stencils.

# At BECKTRONIC, every SMT stencil is a high-end product.

### Your requirements determine the stencil design

Rely on your specialist for the production of SMT stencils for all quick-tensioning systems or in a
fixed frame, step design or with surface finishing: BECKTRONIC produces stencils for optimum
printing results and advises you of process-related issues for your solder paste printing, placement
of adhesive points and special applications. Alongside our SMT stencil range, we also produce wafer
and LTCC stencils.

In addition to our comprehensive technical advice, we offer a standard delivery time of one day for
almost all products - and that is without extra charges or express surcharges. We see ourselves as
partners of our customers - count on our technical know-how as well as more than 30 years of
experience!

### EMS

All-inclusive carefree service: fast and flexible.
Our stencils satisfy with their precise quality - even if work has to be done quickly.

We respond to you swiftly - regardless of production or support inquiries.

### OEM

Together with you, we will develop the perfect stencil for your requirements or optimise existing
processes with high-tech SMD stencils tailored to your individual needs.

Benefit from our many years of technical know-how.

### E^{²}MS

Designing, developing and manufacturing electronic products and components from scratch:

We advise and support you from the beginning in all issues concerning SMD stencils and the solder
paste printing process.

### We have the optimal stencil for every customer

quick-tensioning stencils.

Precise and qualitative top performance - Whether stainless steel or nickel: BECmicro sets targeted

For the application of solder paste onto large PCBs in one step - puts an end to segmented printing.

[ product information ][57]

You are doing a first prototyping and would like to stencil print solder paste on your PCB? No

## **Your Vision?**
## Our stencils.

# At BECKTRONIC, every SMT stencil is a high-end product.

### Your requirements determine the stencil design

Rely on your specialist for the production of SMT stencils for all quick-tensioning systems or in a
fixed frame, step design or with surface finishing: BECKTRONIC produces stencils for optimum
printing results and advises you of process-related issues for your solder paste printing, placement
of adhesive points and special applications. Alongside our SMT stencil range, we also produce wafer
and LTCC stencils.

In addition to our comprehensive technical advice, we offer a standard delivery time of one day for
almost all products - and that is without extra charges or express surcharges. We see ourselves as
partners of our customers - count on our technical know-how as well as more than 30 years of
experience!

### EMS

All-inclusive carefree service: fast and flexible.
Our stencils satisfy with their precise quality - even if work has to be done quickly.

We respond to you swiftly - regardless of production or support inquiries.

### OEM

Together with you, we will develop the perfect stencil for your requirements or optimise existing
processes with high-tech SMD stencils tailored to your individual needs.

Benefit from our many years of technical know-how.

### E^{²}MS

Designing, developing and manufacturing electronic products and components from scratch:

We advise and support you from the beginning in all issues concerning SMD stencils and the solder
paste printing process.

## Our product diversity

### We have the optimal stencil for every customer

### Prototyping stencils

**SMD stencils for optimal and error-free printing results.**

optimal stencil for your application: SMD stencils, step stencils, LTCC stencils, wafer stencils,

storage racks and archiving systems for stencils etc.

[About Us]
[#]
About Us

Founded in 2003, Shenzhen Bicheng Electronics Technology Co., Ltd is an established high frequency
PCB supplier and exporter in Shenzhen China, servicing cellular base station antenna, satellite,
high frequency passive components, microstrip line and band line circuit, millimeter wave equipment,
radar systems, digital radio frequency antenna and other fields worldwide for 20 years. Our high
frequency PCBs are mainly built on 3 high frequency material brands: Rogers Corporation, Taconic and
Wangling. Dielectric constant ranges from 2.2 to 10.2 etc.    We also have divisions of FR-4 circuit
board, flexible circuits and metal core PCBs featured as prototypes, small runs to mass production.
We also actively research and build such high value added PCB projects as HDI, quick turn, impedance
control, heavy copper and backplane board etc. This has made our PCB products generate an effective
prolongation and complementation, as well as formation of integrated products line ranging from
low-end to high-end.    Our PCBs are used for a variety of purposes, including, but not limited to,
computer networking, safety and surveillance, power supply, telecommunication, automotive
electronics, medical apparatus and instruments, national defense and industrial equipment etc.

  Serving Over 200 Brands in the Global PCB - Related Industries
[Why Choose Us]
Why Choose Us

Since our founding in 2003, Shenzhen Bicheng Electronics Technology Co., Ltd has grown into a
globally trusted high-frequency PCB supplier, serving industries such as cellular base station
antennas, satellite communications, millimeter-wave equipment, radar systems, and RF components.
With over 20 years of expertise, we specialize in advanced PCB solutions, combining cutting-edge
materials, precision engineering, and rigorous quality control to meet the most demanding technical
requirements. Diverse Material Expertise We pride ourselves on offering a comprehensive selection of
high-performance PCB materials to suit various applications. Our core high-frequency PCBs are built
on premium substrates from top-tier brands: Rogers Corporation (RO3000, RO4000, RT/duroid, TMM
etc. series)–Ideal for high-speed RF/microwave designs. Taconic (TLX, TLY, RF-35, etc.)–Superior
signal integrity for aerospace and telecom. Wangling–Cost-effective high-frequency laminates with
stable Dk values (2.2–10.2). Beyond high-frequency boards, our product range extends to: FR-4 PCBs:
Standard to advanced multilayer designs for industrial and consumer electronics. Metal Core PCBs
(MCPCB): Optimized for LED lighting, power converters, and thermal management. Flexible & Rigid-Flex
PCBs: Lightweight, durable circuits for wearables, medical devices, and automotive systems. HDI &
Heavy Copper PCBs: High-density interconnects for miniaturized devices and high-power applications .
Precision Manufacturing Capabilities Our state-of-the-art facilities support prototyping to mass
production with unmatched flexibility: Layer Counts: 1–32 layers, with strict impedance control
(±5%). Advanced Technologies: Laser drilling, blind/buried vias, and sequential lamination for HDI
designs. Specialty Finishes: Leaded/Lead-free HASL, Immersion Gold, Immersion Silver, Immersion Tin,
OSP, ENIG, ENEPIG, Carbon Ink, Peelable Mask, Gold Finger, etc. Quality Assurance Quality is
embedded in every step of our process: Incoming material inspection: 100% Dk/Df testing using a
dielectric spectrometer and copper purity verification (99.9% minimum). In-process checks: Automated
AOI after each lamination cycle, with 0.1mm defect detection capability, and ultrasonic testing for
delamination prevention. Final validation: High-potential testing, thermal cycling, and thermal
stress, ionic contamination, Reliability test. . This rigorous approach has earned us a 98% on-time
delivery rate and a customer return rate below 0.1% over the past 20 years. Tailored
Customer-Centric Services We go beyond manufacturing to offer end-to-end support: Engineering
Assistance: DFM reviews and impedance calculations to optimize your design. Low-Volume/High-Mix
Expertise: Cost-effective solutions for niche or evolving projects. Global Logistics: Reliable
shipping with DDU terms to streamline international orders. Trusted by Industries Worldwide Our PCBs
power innovations across sectors: Telecom: 5G antennas, fiber-optic transceivers. Automotive: ADAS
sensors, EV battery management systems. Medical: MRI equipment, implantable device controls.
Aerospace: Avionics, satellite communication modules. At Bicheng Electronics Technology Co., Ltd, we
blend technical excellence, agile production, and uncompromising quality to deliver PCBs that
outperform expectations. Partner with us to turn your designs into reliable, high-performance
reality.
* ISO9001, ISO14001, IATF16949 and UL certified factories.
* Engineering design prevents problems from occurring in pre-production
* One-stop services: Prototypes,medium-sized batches, multi-layer, HDI, high frequency high speed,
  flexible-rigid board.
* AOI, High voltage, Impedance control, Solderability, Thermal stress, Ionic contamination,
  Reliability test
* More than 20+ years of PCB experience
* Delivery on time: >98%
* Customer complaint rate: <1%

About Us

Founded in 2003, Shenzhen Bicheng Electronics Technology Co., Ltd is an established high frequency
PCB supplier and exporter in Shenzhen China, servicing cellular base station antenna, satellite,
high frequency passive components, microstrip line and band line circuit, millimeter wave equipment,
radar systems, digital radio frequency antenna and other fields worldwide for 20 years. Our high
frequency PCBs are mainly built on 3 high frequency material brands: Rogers Corporation, Taconic and
Wangling. Dielectric constant ranges from 2.2 to 10.2 etc.    We also have divisions of FR-4 circuit
board, flexible circuits and metal core PCBs featured as prototypes, small runs to mass production.
We also actively research and build such high value added PCB projects as HDI, quick turn, impedance
control, heavy copper and backplane board etc. This has made our PCB products generate an effective
prolongation and complementation, as well as formation of integrated products line ranging from
low-end to high-end.    Our PCBs are used for a variety of purposes, including, but not limited to,
computer networking, safety and surveillance, power supply, telecommunication, automotive
electronics, medical apparatus and instruments, national defense and industrial equipment etc.

Why Choose Us

Since our founding in 2003, Shenzhen Bicheng Electronics Technology Co., Ltd has grown into a
globally trusted high-frequency PCB supplier, serving industries such as cellular base station
antennas, satellite communications, millimeter-wave equipment, radar systems, and RF components.
With over 20 years of expertise, we specialize in advanced PCB solutions, combining cutting-edge
materials, precision engineering, and rigorous quality control to meet the most demanding technical
requirements. Diverse Material Expertise We pride ourselves on offering a comprehensive selection of
high-performance PCB materials to suit various applications. Our core high-frequency PCBs are built
on premium substrates from top-tier brands: Rogers Corporation (RO3000, RO4000, RT/duroid, TMM
etc. series)–Ideal for high-speed RF/microwave designs. Taconic (TLX, TLY, RF-35, etc.)–Superior
signal integrity for aerospace and telecom. Wangling–Cost-effective high-frequency laminates with
stable Dk values (2.2–10.2). Beyond high-frequency boards, our product range extends to: FR-4 PCBs:
Standard to advanced multilayer designs for industrial and consumer electronics. Metal Core PCBs
(MCPCB): Optimized for LED lighting, power converters, and thermal management. Flexible & Rigid-Flex
PCBs: Lightweight, durable circuits for wearables, medical devices, and automotive systems. HDI &
Heavy Copper PCBs: High-density interconnects for miniaturized devices and high-power applications .
Precision Manufacturing Capabilities Our state-of-the-art facilities support prototyping to mass
production with unmatched flexibility: Layer Counts: 1–32 layers, with strict impedance control
(±5%). Advanced Technologies: Laser drilling, blind/buried vias, and sequential lamination for HDI
designs. Specialty Finishes: Leaded/Lead-free HASL, Immersion Gold, Immersion Silver, Immersion Tin,
OSP, ENIG, ENEPIG, Carbon Ink, Peelable Mask, Gold Finger, etc. Quality Assurance Quality is
embedded in every step of our process: Incoming material inspection: 100% Dk/Df testing using a
dielectric spectrometer and copper purity verification (99.9% minimum). In-process checks: Automated
AOI after each lamination cycle, with 0.1mm defect detection capability, and ultrasonic testing for
delamination prevention. Final validation: High-potential testing, thermal cycling, and thermal
stress, ionic contamination, Reliability test. . This rigorous approach has earned us a 98% on-time
delivery rate and a customer return rate below 0.1% over the past 20 years. Tailored
Customer-Centric Services We go beyond manufacturing to offer end-to-end support: Engineering
Assistance: DFM reviews and impedance calculations to optimize your design. Low-Volume/High-Mix
Expertise: Cost-effective solutions for niche or evolving projects. Global Logistics: Reliable
shipping with DDU terms to streamline international orders. Trusted by Industries Worldwide Our PCBs
power innovations across sectors: Telecom: 5G antennas, fiber-optic transceivers. Automotive: ADAS
sensors, EV battery management systems. Medical: MRI equipment, implantable device controls.
Aerospace: Avionics, satellite communication modules. At Bicheng Electronics Technology Co., Ltd, we
blend technical excellence, agile production, and uncompromising quality to deliver PCBs that
outperform expectations. Partner with us to turn your designs into reliable, high-performance
reality.

communications, high-frequency passive components, microstrip and strip line circuits,
millimeter-wave equipment, radar systems, and digital RF antennas. Our high-frequency PCBs are
primarily manufactured using three leading material brands: Rogers Corporation, Taconic, and

Epec Engineered Technologies is the ideal choice for an OEM seeking customized product solutions
from a focused and agile partner having supported over 5,000 customers across all sectors of the

Your trusted partner for custom printed circuit boards built to your specs, combining precision
manufacturing with rapid turnaround and engineering support. Whether high-volume production or
advanced prototypes, we deliver dependable PCBs that meet the demands of aerospace, medical,
industrial, and defense applications for the most critical electronics.

[Learn More][86]

Advanced flex & rigid-flex circuit boards designed for demanding environments and complex
assemblies. Our custom solutions deliver cost-effective performance in aerospace, medical, and
rugged applications where space, durability, and precision matter. From single- to multi-layer PCBs,
we help you optimize layouts, streamline assembly, and improve reliability in high-performance
systems.

### Advanced PCB Manufacturing Services

Highleap provides industry-leading PCB manufacturing services designed to meet the demands of
high-density, high-performance, and multilayer designs. We specialize in HDI PCBs, Rigid-Flex PCBs,
High-Frequency PCBs, Heavy Copper PCBs, Metal Core PCBs, Flexible PCBs, and Ceramic PCBs, delivering
cutting-edge solutions for a wide range of industries.

Our advanced manufacturing capabilities include 2/2mil line width/spacing, support for up to
60-layer PCB designs, and sophisticated via technologies such as blind vias, buried vias, and
microvias. We leverage premium high-frequency laminates like Rogers, Teflon, and Taconic, as well as
advanced thermal management solutions for demanding applications in high-power and high-speed
environments.

With a focus on precision engineering and rigorous quality assurance, our comprehensive processes
guarantee consistent quality and performance. From compact, high-speed circuits to complex
multilayer PCBs, Highleap delivers unmatched reliability and innovation across industries such as
automotive, aerospace, telecommunications, medical, and renewable energy.

### **香港激光矯視中心 香港首屈一指的矯視中心**

香港激光矯視中心在香港成立 25
年，一直專注為客人提供最優質的眼科及矯視服務。本矯視中心為客人提供SMILE 微笑激光矯視、LASIK
激光矯視、Mosaic PiXL
矯視等多種不同的矯視服務，有效矯正及改善各種眼睛問題。香港的生活繁忙，都市人的生活習慣容易導致各種視
力問題，香港人患上近視的比例更是全球第一，因此香港矯視的需求可以說是十分龐大。激光矯視除了可以讓人不
用再戴眼鏡之外，亦可以治療很多類型的眼睛疾病，例如青光眼及白內障，讓很多人避過失去視力的風險。香港激
光矯視中心是在香港矯視行業首屈一指的矯視中心，曾經服務客人超過十萬個，本矯視中心亦不斷引入先進的矯視
技術及設備，讓客人能夠有機會體驗最新視光科技的好處。

香港激光矯視中心成就包括:
成為完成全香港第 1 個 SMILE 矯視個案的香港矯視中心
已完成超過 110,000 個激光矯視手術個案
2019 及 2020 連續兩年榮獲 Elite Awards 頒發星級眼科矯視科技大獎
榮獲 2022 香港最優秀企業大獎
矯視中心及診所分店網絡遍布世界全球各地，包括中國、美國、歐洲、新加坡及香港


#### **香港激光矯視中心的優勢 **

香港激光矯視中心秉持持續為客人提供優質可靠的矯視服務的宗旨，我們深深地明白到每個人的視力都是至關重要
的，因此我們對矯視服務的每一個範疇都有卓越的追求。

#### **最專業的醫生團隊**

香港激光矯視中心擁有最專業的醫生團隊，所有經本中心的聘用的眼科醫生，特別是為患者進行矯視手術的醫生擁
有豐富的行業經驗及專業背景，他們在進行術前眼科檢查到激光矯視手術的每一個細節都一絲不苟，讓客人能放心
地接受矯視手術。醫生團隊的專業性對於患者矯視手術的效果有顯著的影響，我們的醫生曾經為過萬個客人提供矯
視服務，得到眾多客人的好評。  

#### **先進的矯視技術及設備 **

香港激光矯視中心確保本中心使用最新的技術和設備進行手術。現代的激光矯視技術不斷發展，先進的矯視技術及
設備能夠提供更高的精確度，大大減底矯視手術出錯的機會及縮短患者的復原時間。本中心已添置的矯視技術及設
備包括德國蔡司 Carl Zeiss VisuMax® 飛秒激光系統、美國 IntraLase FS Laser 激光切割器、德國 Wavelight
Allegretto Wave Eye-Q 激光矯視系統、德國 Schwind Amaris 750激光矯視系統、德國蔡司 Carl Zeiss
Humphrey 視野檢查分析儀及各種高分辨率 OCT 醫學成像設備等。

#### **激光矯視 同時處理遠近視及散光問題 **

透過 SMILE 或LASIK
等激光矯視技術，可以有效地處理遠近視及散光問題。近視是香港及全球最常見的視力問題，因為長時間觀看手機
、電腦及缺乏休息，便會容易導致近視度數越來越深。近視患者需要經常依賴眼鏡或隱形眼鏡去糾正視力，但可能
會影響外觀及日常生活，利用激光矯視改變角膜弧度，便可以快速有效改善近視。散光通常會伴隨著近視或遠視存
在，透過激光矯視可以同時處理遠近視及散光問題。  

#### **為甚麼選擇激光矯視？**

在香港，矯視服務的需求不斷增加，激光矯視是作為現今最受歡迎的矯視選擇，因為激光矯視擁有眾多優勢。
**1. 持久改善視力 **
激光矯視手術能夠實現持久的視力改善，長期改善近視、遠視及散光等問題，讓患者能夠不再依賴眼鏡或隱形眼鏡
，實現更自由的生活方式。  
**2. 快速有效 **
激光矯視手術一般只需幾分鐘便可以完成，在手術後你會迅速感受到視力的改善。大多數患者在手術後的幾天內恢
復正常生活，相比於傳統的矯視方法，這是一個極大的優勢。  
**3. 優越的精確度 **
激光矯視手術利用高度精確的激光技術，以微細的程度調整角膜的曲率，從而實現矯視效果。極高的精確度可以提
升手術的效能，避免視力問題再次發生。  
**4. 個性化治療**
激光矯視手術可以根據每個患者的獨特視力問題和需求去制定個性化治療方案。無論是近視、遠視還是散光，甚至
是其他眼睛問題，患者都可以得到最適合自己的矯正方案。  
**5. 成功率高 **
激光矯視手術具有極高的成功率，大多數患者能夠在矯視手術後實現明顯的視力改善。讓它成為一種受歡迎的矯視
方案選擇。

#### **香港激光矯視 常見問題 **

1.香港激光矯視中心有多少間分店診所？
香港激光矯視中心在香港設有兩間分店診所，分別位於中環皇后大道中18號新世界大廈第2期9樓及尖沙咀漢口道4-
6號騏生商業中心7樓及9樓，位置十分方便。

2. 為甚麼香港激光矯視中心是香港矯視行業的優質選擇？
香港激光矯視中心是香港矯視行業的優質選擇，因為本矯視中心的眼科醫生團隊具備良好的資歷及專業的資格及經
驗，而且配備先進的眼科矯視設備及技術。香港激光矯視中心為患者提供最優質的矯視服務，經驗豐富，在香港矯
視行業中擁有良好的口碑。

3. 香港激光矯視中心可以提供甚麼類型的香港矯視服務？
香港激光矯視中心可以提供 SMILE 及 SMILE PRO 微笑矯視、LASIK 激光矯視、ICL
植入式隱形眼鏡等的香港矯視服務。

4. 香港激光矯視中心可以進行常規的眼睛健康檢查嗎？
可以。客人可以在香港激光矯視中心進行常規的眼睛健康檢查，包括成人或兒童的眼睛檢查，以及近視控制檢查等
。

5. 激光矯視可以治療甚麼眼睛問題？
激光矯視可以治療多種不同的眼睛問題，包括近視、遠視、散光、老花等問題。

6. 在香港矯視中心進行激光矯視的流程是怎樣？
在香港矯視中心進行激光矯視前，眼科醫生會先進行詳細的眼科檢查和評估，確定患者是否適合進行激光矯視手術
。合適的患者會在手術室進行激光矯視手術，利用激光矯視技術來重塑角膜的形狀，從而改善視力。矯視手術過程
一般只需十至十五分鐘左右，完成後需要定期覆診跟進眼睛情況。

7. 香港矯視中心會進行哪些測試和檢查去評估我是否適合進行激光矯視手術？
香港矯視中心會進行一系列的測試和檢查，以確定你是否適合進行激光矯視手術。評估項目包括眼科及視力檢查、
屈光度檢測、角膜曲率測試、角膜厚度測量、瞳孔測量以及患者的身體狀況評估等。

8. 激光矯視手術的費用是多少？
激光矯視手術包括SMILE PRO、SMILE 、 LASIK及PRESBYMAX
等，因應不同的技術及方式所涉的費用會有所不同。激光矯視手術費用通常已經包括手術費用、基本藥物費用及後
續跟進的費用。你可以向本矯視中心的職員查詢有關激光矯視手術費用的詳細資料。

9. 激光矯視手術後，需要多長時間才能恢復正常視力？
激光矯視手術後的恢復時間因個人而異，但大多數人在矯視手術後的幾天內便會恢復大部分的視力。然而，完全恢
復達到最佳視力可能需要幾個星期至幾個月的時間。

10. 完成激光矯視手術後是否可以一勞永逸？
完成激光矯視手術可以長期改善視力，但不能保證一勞永逸。部分人可能會在激光矯視術後出現度數反彈，需要再
次進行增進手術，而即使沒有出現度數反彈，長期過度使用眼睛或不良習慣等仍會令遠近視及散光等眼睛問題再次
出現。

11. 甚麼人不適合接受激光矯視手術？
眼球尚未發育完成、遠近視度數尚未穩定或太深、角膜太薄、患有圓錐角膜、眼睛淚水分泌太少等的人士可能不適
合接受激光矯視手術。

12. 我的健康狀況會否影響我接受激光矯視手術？
如患有某些疾病，如糖尿病、自身免疫性疾病、眼睛受傷及眼部疾病或懷孕等都可能會影響接受激光矯視。因此在
接受激光矯視前，患者會經過全面的評估及檢查，確定合適才會進行。

13. 如果想了解更多有關眼睛問題的資料，有甚麼途徑？
如果想了解更多有關眼睛問題的資料，可以經本矯視中心網站預約不同主題的講座，講座會以廣東話/英文/普通話
形式進行。

14. 如何預約香港激光矯視中心的服務？
如客人有需要預約香港激光矯視中心的服務，可以根據自己方便的位置，致電附近的矯視中心分店診所預約及查詢
詳細資料。

用再戴眼鏡之外，亦可以治療很多類型的眼睛疾病，例如青光眼及白內障，讓很多人避過失去視力的風險。香港激
光矯視中心是在香港矯視行業首屈一指的矯視中心，曾經服務客人超過十萬個，本矯視中心亦不斷引入先進的矯視
技術及設備，讓客人能夠有機會體驗最新視光科技的好處。

香港激光矯視中心成就包括:
成為完成全香港第 1 個 SMILE 矯視個案的香港矯視中心
已完成超過 110,000 個激光矯視手術個案
2019 及 2020 連續兩年榮獲 Elite Awards 頒發星級眼科矯視科技大獎
榮獲 2022 香港最優秀企業大獎
矯視中心及診所分店網絡遍布世界全球各地，包括中國、美國、歐洲、新加坡及香港


#### **香港激光矯視中心的優勢 **

香港激光矯視中心秉持持續為客人提供優質可靠的矯視服務的宗旨，我們深深地明白到每個人的視力都是至關重要
的，因此我們對矯視服務的每一個範疇都有卓越的追求。

#### **最專業的醫生團隊**

香港激光矯視中心擁有最專業的醫生團隊，所有經本中心的聘用的眼科醫生，特別是為患者進行矯視手術的醫生擁
有豐富的行業經驗及專業背景，他們在進行術前眼科檢查到激光矯視手術的每一個細節都一絲不苟，讓客人能放心
地接受矯視手術。醫生團隊的專業性對於患者矯視手術的效果有顯著的影響，我們的醫生曾經為過萬個客人提供矯
視服務，得到眾多客人的好評。  

#### **先進的矯視技術及設備 **

香港激光矯視中心確保本中心使用最新的技術和設備進行手術。現代的激光矯視技術不斷發展，先進的矯視技術及
設備能夠提供更高的精確度，大大減底矯視手術出錯的機會及縮短患者的復原時間。本中心已添置的矯視技術及設
備包括德國蔡司 Carl Zeiss VisuMax® 飛秒激光系統、美國 IntraLase FS Laser 激光切割器、德國 Wavelight
Allegretto Wave Eye-Q 激光矯視系統、德國 Schwind Amaris 750激光矯視系統、德國蔡司 Carl Zeiss
Humphrey 視野檢查分析儀及各種高分辨率 OCT 醫學成像設備等。

#### **激光矯視 同時處理遠近視及散光問題 **

透過 SMILE 或LASIK
等激光矯視技術，可以有效地處理遠近視及散光問題。近視是香港及全球最常見的視力問題，因為長時間觀看手機
、電腦及缺乏休息，便會容易導致近視度數越來越深。近視患者需要經常依賴眼鏡或隱形眼鏡去糾正視力，但可能
會影響外觀及日常生活，利用激光矯視改變角膜弧度，便可以快速有效改善近視。散光通常會伴隨著近視或遠視存
在，透過激光矯視可以同時處理遠近視及散光問題。  

#### **為甚麼選擇激光矯視？**

在香港，矯視服務的需求不斷增加，激光矯視是作為現今最受歡迎的矯視選擇，因為激光矯視擁有眾多優勢。
**1. 持久改善視力 **
激光矯視手術能夠實現持久的視力改善，長期改善近視、遠視及散光等問題，讓患者能夠不再依賴眼鏡或隱形眼鏡
，實現更自由的生活方式。  
**2. 快速有效 **
激光矯視手術一般只需幾分鐘便可以完成，在手術後你會迅速感受到視力的改善。大多數患者在手術後的幾天內恢
復正常生活，相比於傳統的矯視方法，這是一個極大的優勢。  
**3. 優越的精確度 **
激光矯視手術利用高度精確的激光技術，以微細的程度調整角膜的曲率，從而實現矯視效果。極高的精確度可以提
升手術的效能，避免視力問題再次發生。  
**4. 個性化治療**
激光矯視手術可以根據每個患者的獨特視力問題和需求去制定個性化治療方案。無論是近視、遠視還是散光，甚至
是其他眼睛問題，患者都可以得到最適合自己的矯正方案。  
**5. 成功率高 **
激光矯視手術具有極高的成功率，大多數患者能夠在矯視手術後實現明顯的視力改善。讓它成為一種受歡迎的矯視
方案選擇。

香港激光矯視中心在香港設有兩間分店診所，分別位於中環皇后大道中18號新世界大廈第2期9樓及尖沙咀漢口道4-
6號騏生商業中心7樓及9樓，位置十分方便。

2. 為甚麼香港激光矯視中心是香港矯視行業的優質選擇？
香港激光矯視中心是香港矯視行業的優質選擇，因為本矯視中心的眼科醫生團隊具備良好的資歷及專業的資格及經
驗，而且配備先進的眼科矯視設備及技術。香港激光矯視中心為患者提供最優質的矯視服務，經驗豐富，在香港矯
視行業中擁有良好的口碑。

3. 香港激光矯視中心可以提供甚麼類型的香港矯視服務？
香港激光矯視中心可以提供 SMILE 及 SMILE PRO 微笑矯視、LASIK 激光矯視、ICL
植入式隱形眼鏡等的香港矯視服務。

4. 香港激光矯視中心可以進行常規的眼睛健康檢查嗎？
可以。客人可以在香港激光矯視中心進行常規的眼睛健康檢查，包括成人或兒童的眼睛檢查，以及近視控制檢查等
。

5. 激光矯視可以治療甚麼眼睛問題？
激光矯視可以治療多種不同的眼睛問題，包括近視、遠視、散光、老花等問題。

6. 在香港矯視中心進行激光矯視的流程是怎樣？
在香港矯視中心進行激光矯視前，眼科醫生會先進行詳細的眼科檢查和評估，確定患者是否適合進行激光矯視手術
。合適的患者會在手術室進行激光矯視手術，利用激光矯視技術來重塑角膜的形狀，從而改善視力。矯視手術過程
一般只需十至十五分鐘左右，完成後需要定期覆診跟進眼睛情況。

7. 香港矯視中心會進行哪些測試和檢查去評估我是否適合進行激光矯視手術？
香港矯視中心會進行一系列的測試和檢查，以確定你是否適合進行激光矯視手術。評估項目包括眼科及視力檢查、
屈光度檢測、角膜曲率測試、角膜厚度測量、瞳孔測量以及患者的身體狀況評估等。

激光矯視手術包括SMILE PRO、SMILE 、 LASIK及PRESBYMAX
等，因應不同的技術及方式所涉的費用會有所不同。激光矯視手術費用通常已經包括手術費用、基本藥物費用及後
續跟進的費用。你可以向本矯視中心的職員查詢有關激光矯視手術費用的詳細資料。

9. 激光矯視手術後，需要多長時間才能恢復正常視力？
激光矯視手術後的恢復時間因個人而異，但大多數人在矯視手術後的幾天內便會恢復大部分的視力。然而，完全恢
復達到最佳視力可能需要幾個星期至幾個月的時間。

10. 完成激光矯視手術後是否可以一勞永逸？
完成激光矯視手術可以長期改善視力，但不能保證一勞永逸。部分人可能會在激光矯視術後出現度數反彈，需要再
次進行增進手術，而即使沒有出現度數反彈，長期過度使用眼睛或不良習慣等仍會令遠近視及散光等眼睛問題再次
出現。

11. 甚麼人不適合接受激光矯視手術？
眼球尚未發育完成、遠近視度數尚未穩定或太深、角膜太薄、患有圓錐角膜、眼睛淚水分泌太少等的人士可能不適
合接受激光矯視手術。

12. 我的健康狀況會否影響我接受激光矯視手術？
如患有某些疾病，如糖尿病、自身免疫性疾病、眼睛受傷及眼部疾病或懷孕等都可能會影響接受激光矯視。因此在
接受激光矯視前，患者會經過全面的評估及檢查，確定合適才會進行。

如果想了解更多有關眼睛問題的資料，可以經本矯視中心網站預約不同主題的講座，講座會以廣東話/英文/普通話
形式進行。

如客人有需要預約香港激光矯視中心的服務，可以根據自己方便的位置，致電附近的矯視中心分店診所預約及查詢

在，透過激光矯視可以同時處理遠近視及散光問題。

視行業中擁有良好的口碑。

激光矯視可以治療多種不同的眼睛問題，包括近視、遠視、散光、老花等問題。

眼球尚未發育完成、遠近視度數尚未穩定或太深、角膜太薄、患有圓錐角膜、眼睛淚水分泌太少等的人士可能不適

如果想了解更多有關眼睛問題的資料，可以經本矯視中心網站預約不同主題的講座，講座會以廣東話/英文/普通話
形式進行。

1.香港激光矯視中心有多少間分店診所？
香港激光矯視中心在香港設有兩間分店診所，分別位於中環皇后大道中18號新世界大廈第2期9樓及尖沙咀漢口道4-
6號騏生商業中心7樓及9樓，位置十分方便。

2. 為甚麼香港激光矯視中心是香港矯視行業的優質選擇？
香港激光矯視中心是香港矯視行業的優質選擇，因為本矯視中心的眼科醫生團隊具備良好的資歷及專業的資格及經
驗，而且配備先進的眼科矯視設備及技術。香港激光矯視中心為患者提供最優質的矯視服務，經驗豐富，在香港矯
視行業中擁有良好的口碑。

3. 香港激光矯視中心可以提供甚麼類型的香港矯視服務？
香港激光矯視中心可以提供 SMILE 及 SMILE PRO 微笑矯視、LASIK 激光矯視、ICL
植入式隱形眼鏡等的香港矯視服務。

4. 香港激光矯視中心可以進行常規的眼睛健康檢查嗎？
可以。客人可以在香港激光矯視中心進行常規的眼睛健康檢查，包括成人或兒童的眼睛檢查，以及近視控制檢查等
。

5. 激光矯視可以治療甚麼眼睛問題？
激光矯視可以治療多種不同的眼睛問題，包括近視、遠視、散光、老花等問題。

6. 在香港矯視中心進行激光矯視的流程是怎樣？
在香港矯視中心進行激光矯視前，眼科醫生會先進行詳細的眼科檢查和評估，確定患者是否適合進行激光矯視手術
。合適的患者會在手術室進行激光矯視手術，利用激光矯視技術來重塑角膜的形狀，從而改善視力。矯視手術過程
一般只需十至十五分鐘左右，完成後需要定期覆診跟進眼睛情況。

7. 香港矯視中心會進行哪些測試和檢查去評估我是否適合進行激光矯視手術？
香港矯視中心會進行一系列的測試和檢查，以確定你是否適合進行激光矯視手術。評估項目包括眼科及視力檢查、
屈光度檢測、角膜曲率測試、角膜厚度測量、瞳孔測量以及患者的身體狀況評估等。

8. 激光矯視手術的費用是多少？
激光矯視手術包括SMILE PRO、SMILE 、 LASIK及PRESBYMAX
等，因應不同的技術及方式所涉的費用會有所不同。激光矯視手術費用通常已經包括手術費用、基本藥物費用及後
續跟進的費用。你可以向本矯視中心的職員查詢有關激光矯視手術費用的詳細資料。

9. 激光矯視手術後，需要多長時間才能恢復正常視力？
激光矯視手術後的恢復時間因個人而異，但大多數人在矯視手術後的幾天內便會恢復大部分的視力。然而，完全恢
復達到最佳視力可能需要幾個星期至幾個月的時間。

10. 完成激光矯視手術後是否可以一勞永逸？
完成激光矯視手術可以長期改善視力，但不能保證一勞永逸。部分人可能會在激光矯視術後出現度數反彈，需要再
次進行增進手術，而即使沒有出現度數反彈，長期過度使用眼睛或不良習慣等仍會令遠近視及散光等眼睛問題再次
出現。

11. 甚麼人不適合接受激光矯視手術？
眼球尚未發育完成、遠近視度數尚未穩定或太深、角膜太薄、患有圓錐角膜、眼睛淚水分泌太少等的人士可能不適
合接受激光矯視手術。

12. 我的健康狀況會否影響我接受激光矯視手術？
如患有某些疾病，如糖尿病、自身免疫性疾病、眼睛受傷及眼部疾病或懷孕等都可能會影響接受激光矯視。因此在
接受激光矯視前，患者會經過全面的評估及檢查，確定合適才會進行。

13. 如果想了解更多有關眼睛問題的資料，有甚麼途徑？
如果想了解更多有關眼睛問題的資料，可以經本矯視中心網站預約不同主題的講座，講座會以廣東話/英文/普通話
形式進行。

14. 如何預約香港激光矯視中心的服務？
如客人有需要預約香港激光矯視中心的服務，可以根據自己方便的位置，致電附近的矯視中心分店診所預約及查詢
詳細資料。

客人也可以與他的眼科醫生預約使用我們中心的設施進行激光矯視。

### 01 Upload PCB Files
* Upload your Gerber files, Bill of Materials (BOM), and Component Placement List (CPL) to receive

All uploads are secure and confidential.

### 02 Review PCB Components
* Our system automatically matches and selects parts based on your BOM. You simply need to review
  and confirm the selections.
* Our interactive 3D viewer shows your board and component placements, helping you spot any mistakes
  before ordering.

### 03 Order & Track
* Place orders in minutes and track order status in real-time. Visual progress tracking shows every

* By streamlining the entire process—from ordering and parts sourcing to PCBA prototyping—you can

## LiMaB GmbH – Your partner for high-quality laser processing

#### Certified quality, reliable since 1990

LiMaB GmbH was founded in 1990, when engineer Günter Bartsch took the plunge into self-employment.
He was fascinated by laser beam technology, which was still in its infancy at the time, and it went
on to shape his life.

[Learn more about us][29]

sheet metal (up to 3 mm thick) as well as plastic films (from 7.5 µm thick), we have...

Printed circuit board manufacturers in Europe are increasingly becoming specialists in sophisticated
technologies (multilayer, flex, and rigid-flex) ...

[learn more][31]

### SMD - Stencils

The application of solder paste or adhesive to unassembled printed circuit boards in SMT (surface
mounting technology) is currently mostly carried out in ...

[learn more][32]

### Laser marking

It all started with laser marking. Since 1991, laser marking, laser engraving, and laser etching
have been part of LiMaB's range of services...

[learn more][33]

### Laser welding

With the universal tool that is the laser, we can not only cut and remove materials, but also join
them together. The laser beam heats the material in the focus area above its melting temperature.
The resulting melts mix together and solidify again to form a strong bond. This process takes only a
few milliseconds and requires no additional materials. However, laser welding without additional
material requires very narrow gap widths...

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

# Kontrak AI-robotiese PCB-vervaardiger, AI-bediener PCB-samestelling fabriek in Shenzhen

## Voorste IPCIII MCPCB-Buig-Rogers PCB-vervaardiger, fokus op blinde via HDI-impedansie PCB.
## Professionele PCB-samestelling vir AI-robotika, motorvoertuie, militêre en RF-mikrogolfradar,
## pasgemaakte PCBA OEM, BGA-herstel, komponentvoorraad geleë in HK en Shenzhen. Komponentbiblioteek
## versnel vinnige BOM-aanbieding en verkryging. eMMC-geheugen PCBA-samestelling, hoëfrekwensie

## Avoid Fabrication Delays!

[Smart dfm showcase]

### Smart DFM with Custom Rule Checks

Smart DFM is a software tool that helps PCB designers and engineers ensure their boards are
manufacturable and error-free before sending them to fabrication.
* [Bullet point check outline] Automated DFM Checks
  Scans Gerber and drill files for manufacturing issues like spacing violations, missing clearances,
  or unconnected nets.
* [Bullet point check outline] Custom Rule Support
  Define design rules to match manufacturer requirements or internal standards.
* [Bullet point check outline] Error Highlighting & Guidance
  Flags violations and provides actionable guidance for corrections.
* [Bullet point check outline] Prevents Costly Rework
  Catching errors early reduces the risk of board failures, re-spins, or production delays.

# **Top 1 Turnkey SMT Line Solutions Expert in China**

Meraif is China’s leading provider of comprehensive SMT (Surface Mount Technology) plant solutions.
With over 20 years of hands-on experience in SMT factory operations, we specialize in offering
professional guidance and turnkey solutions for SMT plant construction worldwide.
[Keep in Touch with Our SMT Specialist →][136]
More than 5000+ clients
[Client][Client][Client]
2000+ ratings

## Comprehensive SMT Plant Solutions

Meraif is China’s leading provider of comprehensive SMT (Surface Mount Technology) plant solutions.
With over 20 years of hands-on experience in SMT factory operations, we oﬀer end-to-end support –
from initial consultation and factory layout to equipment integration and training – ensuring a
smooth, eﬃcient production line. Our services cover every stage of a project: equipment selection,
line design, installation, calibration, and commissioning. In other words, we handle the entire
“0-to-1” SMT factory build process so you can start manufacturing as quickly and reliably as
possible. We take a partnership approach to understand your needs and deliver smarter, tailored
solutions. Ultimately, Meraif gives you a turnkey SMT assembly line – a complete, ready-to-run
production setup including all machines, conveyors, and software – customized to your board designs,
throughput requirements, and budget.
[Explore Our Solutions][137]

## Our Services for SMT Lines

End-to-end SMT solutions: turnkey line design/build, mixed & custom configurations, high-speed and
prototype lines—plus genuine spare parts, operator training, and ongoing service.
1

### Turnkey SMT Line Construction

We provide full-cycle SMT line services. That means total project management from planning and
design through equipment procurement, factory layout, installation, and ﬁnal testing. Our turnkey
solutions cover every step, including operator training and documentation, so you receive a
ready-to-run line.
2

### Mixed & Flexible SMT Lines

We design ﬂexible lines that can mix machines from diﬀerent brands or technologies. This is ideal
for high-mix, low-volume production (small batches or prototyping) where quick changeovers and
versatility are needed. Our mixed-technology lines (e.g. dual-lane pick-and-place) let you assemble
multiple product types or run two models simultaneously, giving you the best of speed and
ﬂexibility.
3

### High-Speed Mass Production Lines

For high-volume manufacturing, we build fully automated SMT lines optimized for one or a few PCBA
designs. These low-mix, high throughput lines use top-speed pick-and-place machines, large reﬂow
ovens, inline inspection, and conveyors to maximize output. Such lines – commonly used in consumer
electronics, automotive, and telecom – can produce thousands of boards per day.
4

### Prototype & Small-Batch Lines

We also specialize in compact SMT setups for R&D and small-batch runs. These quick-turn lines allow
easy setup changes and in-line inspection, enabling you to validate new products or fulﬁll custom
orders without the overhead of a full production line. High-mix low-volume (HMLV) lines are valuable
for aerospace, medical, telecom prototypes and specialty electronics.
5

### Spare Parts & Accessories Supply

As a one-stop supplier, Meraif carries a full inventory of SMT spare parts and accessories for all
major equipment. From feeders and nozzles to belts, sensors, and replacement PCBs, we source both
new and refurbished parts. (As Goldland notes, you can “purchase all the SMT parts you need at one
stop”.) Having on-hand parts matching your machines’ brands ensures minimal downtime.
6

### Training & After-Sales Support

Beyond equipment, we provide thorough operator training and technical support. Our experts train
your team on programming and operating each machine – as one solutions provider recommends,
understanding machine programming is “crucial for a smoothly running assembly line”. We also oﬀer
24/7 maintenance support and preventive service. In line with best practices, we help eliminate
potential issues, keep your line calibrated, and respond quickly to any questions or repairs.

## Our Product Range for SMT Lines Solution

Meraif supplies a comprehensive range of SMT equipment and materials, covering every part of the
production line

# **Top 1 Turnkey SMT Line Solutions Expert in China**

Meraif is China’s leading provider of comprehensive SMT (Surface Mount Technology) plant solutions.
With over 20 years of hands-on experience in SMT factory operations, we specialize in offering
professional guidance and turnkey solutions for SMT plant construction worldwide.
[Keep in Touch with Our SMT Specialist →][136]
More than 5000+ clients
[Client][Client][Client]
2000+ ratings

## Comprehensive SMT Plant Solutions

Meraif is China’s leading provider of comprehensive SMT (Surface Mount Technology) plant solutions.
With over 20 years of hands-on experience in SMT factory operations, we oﬀer end-to-end support –
from initial consultation and factory layout to equipment integration and training – ensuring a
smooth, eﬃcient production line. Our services cover every stage of a project: equipment selection,
line design, installation, calibration, and commissioning. In other words, we handle the entire
“0-to-1” SMT factory build process so you can start manufacturing as quickly and reliably as
possible. We take a partnership approach to understand your needs and deliver smarter, tailored
solutions. Ultimately, Meraif gives you a turnkey SMT assembly line – a complete, ready-to-run
production setup including all machines, conveyors, and software – customized to your board designs,
throughput requirements, and budget.
[Explore Our Solutions][137]

## Our Services for SMT Lines

End-to-end SMT solutions: turnkey line design/build, mixed & custom configurations, high-speed and
prototype lines—plus genuine spare parts, operator training, and ongoing service.
1

### Turnkey SMT Line Construction

We provide full-cycle SMT line services. That means total project management from planning and
design through equipment procurement, factory layout, installation, and ﬁnal testing. Our turnkey
solutions cover every step, including operator training and documentation, so you receive a
ready-to-run line.
2

### Mixed & Flexible SMT Lines

We design ﬂexible lines that can mix machines from diﬀerent brands or technologies. This is ideal
for high-mix, low-volume production (small batches or prototyping) where quick changeovers and
versatility are needed. Our mixed-technology lines (e.g. dual-lane pick-and-place) let you assemble
multiple product types or run two models simultaneously, giving you the best of speed and
ﬂexibility.
3

### High-Speed Mass Production Lines

For high-volume manufacturing, we build fully automated SMT lines optimized for one or a few PCBA
designs. These low-mix, high throughput lines use top-speed pick-and-place machines, large reﬂow
ovens, inline inspection, and conveyors to maximize output. Such lines – commonly used in consumer
electronics, automotive, and telecom – can produce thousands of boards per day.
4

### Prototype & Small-Batch Lines

We also specialize in compact SMT setups for R&D and small-batch runs. These quick-turn lines allow
easy setup changes and in-line inspection, enabling you to validate new products or fulﬁll custom
orders without the overhead of a full production line. High-mix low-volume (HMLV) lines are valuable
for aerospace, medical, telecom prototypes and specialty electronics.
5

### Spare Parts & Accessories Supply

As a one-stop supplier, Meraif carries a full inventory of SMT spare parts and accessories for all
major equipment. From feeders and nozzles to belts, sensors, and replacement PCBs, we source both
new and refurbished parts. (As Goldland notes, you can “purchase all the SMT parts you need at one
stop”.) Having on-hand parts matching your machines’ brands ensures minimal downtime.
6

### Training & After-Sales Support

Beyond equipment, we provide thorough operator training and technical support. Our experts train
your team on programming and operating each machine – as one solutions provider recommends,
understanding machine programming is “crucial for a smoothly running assembly line”. We also oﬀer
24/7 maintenance support and preventive service. In line with best practices, we help eliminate
potential issues, keep your line calibrated, and respond quickly to any questions or repairs.

## Our Product Range for SMT Lines Solution

Meraif supplies a comprehensive range of SMT equipment and materials, covering every part of the
production line

## Complete PCB Fabrication & Assembly Services Manufacturer

 PNC Inc. is an industry-leading, single-source manufacturer of high-reliability [Printed Circuit
Boards (PCBs][232]) and [PCB Assembly][233]. Established in 1969, we proudly serve a nationwide
clientele across the United States, Canada and Mexico delivering advanced solutions for the Defense
(DoD), Aerospace, [RF][234], Medical, and Commercial sectors.

By integrating complete PCB fabrication and assembly under one roof, we eliminate supply chain
friction to offer the fastest turnaround times in the industry. PNC Inc. is fully committed to the
highest quality standards, maintaining [AS9100D][235], ISO9001:2015,[ ITAR registered PCB assembly
northeast][236], J-STD, Certified, [MBE Electronics & PCB Assembly Manufacturer][237] and IPC Class
III and UL certifications.

# USA PCB Manufacturing & Assembly (Turnkey) | PNC Inc.

## Single-Source PCB Solution

## Complete PCB Fabrication & Assembly Services Manufacturer

 PNC Inc. is an industry-leading, single-source manufacturer of high-reliability [Printed Circuit
Boards (PCBs][232]) and [PCB Assembly][233]. Established in 1969, we proudly serve a nationwide
clientele across the United States, Canada and Mexico delivering advanced solutions for the Defense
(DoD), Aerospace, [RF][234], Medical, and Commercial sectors.

By integrating complete PCB fabrication and assembly under one roof, we eliminate supply chain
friction to offer the fastest turnaround times in the industry. PNC Inc. is fully committed to the
highest quality standards, maintaining [AS9100D][235], ISO9001:2015,[ ITAR registered PCB assembly
northeast][236], J-STD, Certified, [MBE Electronics & PCB Assembly Manufacturer][237] and IPC Class
III and UL certifications. 

Below, you will find a list of our PC board related products and services including [PCB
Design][238], PCB Manufacturing and PCB Assembly. 

## Our Products & Services
* ### [PCB Design from schematics or concepts][239]
* ### [PC Board Manufacturing - USA][240]
  * [Prototype PC Boards][241]
  * Metal Core/Hybrid PC Boards
  * [RF/Microwave PCBs][242]
  * [IPC 6012 CLASS III Certified PC boards][243]
* ### [PC Board Assembly][244]
* ### [Flex & Rigi-Flex PCBs - Quick turn and production][245]
* 

## PNC’s Strongest Deliverables:
* Simple to High-end PCB Design from schematics or concept
* Quick Turn Quick Turn [**Prototypes PC Boards**][246] from 24 hrs turnaround time
* 2-40 Layers High Density Multilayer PCBs (Quick Turn to High volume)
* Blind and Buried vias Multilayer PCBs including Rogers Materials
* [**RoHs**][247] Finishes(LF-HAL, ENIG,SOFT/HARD Gold, Tin, Silver & OSP)
* UL approved for High Tg
* Produced with top of the line ISOLA370HR, High Tg 180 materials
* 100% final inspection and netlist testing(5 Flying Probe testers)
* Our China partners are UL approved for PNC’s UL Logo.
* Very competitive price structure for Prototype PC Boards
* Online live order tracking via our Website
* Express PCB RFQ reply within 30 min or less for [** prototype PCB**][248]
* Superior customer service &instant response to customer’s inquiries
* E-mail notification upon job shipment with tracking number
* We participate [**KANBAN and JIT**][249] Programs
* High-volume production from our offshore partners at very attractive prices. Our offshore boards
  are 100% tested, inspected, and certified by PNC USA before being shipped.
* A printed circuit boards serves as "The Chassis of Electronics". In today's race to market new
  products, quick-turn PC boards can give you the edge you need to stay above the competition. PNC
  Inc. is the kind of reliable PC board manufacturer you can count on to deliver speedy PCB
  prototype runs and has the longevity (in business for over 55+ years) to be here when your
  prototype PCBs turn into production. Please allow us to quote your requirements, from [**Prototype
  PC Boards**][250] to mid- and high-volume production runs.

## Why Choose Us?

### Quality, affordable and reliable PCBs & PCB Assemblies

QualiEco Circuits, a reputable brand established in 2003, is excited to announce its expansion into
Canada's electronic industry. With over two decades of experience serving businesses in Australia
and New Zealand, we now bring our high-quality PCB manufacturing, circuit assembly, cable assembly,
and turnkey solutions to Canada and North America. Experience excellence and reliability with
QualiEco Circuits as your electronic manufacturing partner.

In our journey to offer the best customer service to our customers in since 2003, we also possess
the **ISO 9001:2015 & ISO 13485:2016** **(Medical Devices - Quality Management System)**
certificates for QualiEco Canada, Australia and New Zealand that demonstrate our commitment to
continuous improvement in quality and services in PCB manufacturing and assembly.

### We offer a true One-Stop solution with our wide range of services in PCB and PCBA in standard
### and fast turnaround options

PCB Manufacturing - Rigid, Flexible, Rigid-flexible (hybrid), Metal-core, HDI, High-Frequency PCBs
Component Procurement - Full or Partial Electronic component kitting (SMD/TH - Passive/Active)
SMT Stencil Manufacturing - Framed and Frameless Electropolish Laser Cut Stencils
PCB Assembly - Full or Partial Turnkey Assembly (Surface Mount & Through-hole - Leaded or Lead-free)

assemblies, as well as cable and harness assemblies.

Radian Technology is proud to announce the installation of an additional photographic inspection
camera used alongside the scancad scanner system to verify 100% complete cut thru on every stencil
delivered.

In addition, all fiber diode laser systems have been upgraded with the latest Intel i7 Quad Core
enabling faster processing of todays complex circuit board designs

**August 1, 2011**

Radian Technology is proud to announce the purchase and installation of the 2011 ScanCad Stencil
Inspection System. We can now utilize the latest in micro scanning technology to offer:

100% automatic inspection of screen/stencil for absence/presence and size of apertures.

**Sept 10, 2008**

Radian Technology is proud to announce the installation of a second fiber diode laser system. We can
now achieve zero downtime and increase capability to better serve and meet our customer delivery
times.

## Why ResaLaser HK ?

After its sixteen years of popularity in Taiwan’s well-known 147 Sports Theme
Park,Resalaser is now bringing the exciting lasertag experience to Hong Kong.
The game is played with low degrees of laser lights, allowing a safe and painless,
fun and exciting combat experience. We’ve collaborated with an experienced
Amercian professional team to invent new equipment which is a 147-NSLT
system that surpassess the old style infra-red lasers.
With increasing accuracy and sense of reality, the new 147-NSLT system uses
laser lights that are highly directional and have low degrees of diffusion.


There are various game modes with different levels of intensity allowing for
a various age groups or group functions to have their own personalized
experience.
Professional strategic players are also welcome for an exciting tactical game.


ResalaserHK's first branch began to establish at Mong Kok since 2015.
And now comprises two branches at Kwun Tong and Lai Chi Kok D2 Place one
where are exceed 10,000sq ft and accomodate up to 150 guests.
We keep providing Lasertag activities along with multifunctional and creative

Park,Resalaser is now bringing the exciting lasertag experience to Hong Kong.
The game is played with low degrees of laser lights, allowing a safe and painless,
fun and exciting combat experience. We’ve collaborated with an experienced
Amercian professional team to invent new equipment which is a 147-NSLT
system that surpassess the old style infra-red lasers.
With increasing accuracy and sense of reality, the new 147-NSLT system uses
laser lights that are highly directional and have low degrees of diffusion.


There are various game modes with different levels of intensity allowing for
a various age groups or group functions to have their own personalized
experience.

## Our Major PCB Services

Well Done Technology focuses on PCB reverse engineering, PCB clone, and IC unlock. Our technical
team of more than 40 people includes senior engineers with rich experience. Founded in 2008, we have
completed over 1,000 PCB engineering projects for clients worldwide, including North America,
Europe, and Southeast Asia.

## PCB Reverse Engineering Service Capabilities

Our **PCB reverse engineering service** helps recover manufacturable design data from legacy boards,
discontinued electronics, damaged samples, or products without original CAD files. The goal is not
only to copy board geometry, but also to rebuild useful engineering outputs such as schematic
diagrams, BOM information, Gerber files, netlists, and PCB layout files for repair, redesign, or
controlled production.

**Quality checks for reverse engineered PCB files:** before delivery, files should be checked
against the physical board, component orientation, net continuity, design rules, drill data, and
manufacturing constraints. Common references include IPC-A-600 for board acceptability, IPC-6012 for
rigid PCB performance, and IPC-2221/IPC-2222 for general design guidance.

### PCB Reverse Engineering

The PCB reverse engineering services includes pcb to schematic, [gerber files][68], design layout
optimization. Our experts can guarantee to make 100% accurate pcb schematic diagrams. Many
well-known international customers have also accredited us in various aerospace manufacturing
companies or military industries.
[ Check Details ][69]

### IC Unlock

Our engineers can [copy programs from your microcontrollers][70] or reprogram them with new firmware
as needed. We utilize various approaches and advanced equipment to unlock integrated circuits (ICs),
including [MCU][71], FPGAs, DSPs, ARMs, and CPLDs. Additionally, we support [IC series][72] from
manufacturers such as Actel, Atmel, Microchip, and STCmicro.
[ Check Details ][73]

### PCB Design

You can benefit from our professional printed circuit board design process from pcb layout to [pcb
stack-up][74] and [creating PCB schematic design][75]. When the project is beginning, our pcb design
engineers will build your pcb engineering by [pcb design software][76]. We'll use popular programs
like Altium Designer,KiCAD and more.
[ Check Details ][77]

### PCB Repair

Common pcb repair engineering includes component rework, surface mount pads, solder mask repair,
de-solder and relayout of boards. Furthermore,you can request making changes to fix an existing
design flaw. Just send your circuit board to us, our technicians will work quickly and efficiently
to get it repaired.
[ Check Details ][78]

## PCB Reverse Engineering Procedures

#1 - ICs Unlock (Optional)
Extract the program from Board 25%
#2 - PCB Reverse Engineering
Get gerber file & BOM list, create layout and generate a schematic 50%
#3 - Prototype PCB Fabrication
Building and producing the pcb sample with schematic 75%
#4 - PCB Functional Testing
Inspect the performance of the new board, troubleshoot issues, and fix incompatibilities before the
mass production 100%

## What We Need Before Quoting a PCB Reverse Engineering Project

For a reliable quote, please share board photos, board dimensions, layer count if known,
component-side images, any available firmware or part markings, and the expected output files. For
multilayer PCBs, destructive layer-by-layer analysis may be required when internal traces, blind
vias, buried vias, or controlled impedance structures cannot be confirmed from the outside.

───────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────

symptoms           │troubleshooting                             │redesign advice                    
───────────────────┴────────────────────────────────────────────┴───────────────────────────────────

## Value-Added Services

Looking for more service about PCB engineering? You can benefit from our wide range of services as
below. And our experts will ensure no delays due to quality or errors while working on your project.

### PCB Stackup Design

When designing a PCB stackup, we can help our customers guide, create or verify the stackup. They
are suitable for all impedance control requirements for single-ended, differential pair, coplanar
waveguide and other technologies.

### controlled impedance PCB

Due to the growing application of low-impedance circuits, low-impedance modeling has become an
important aspect of circuit design. If you have mpedance-controlled requirements, we can help you
for controlled impedance modeling.

### Design Rule Checking

Design Rule Check verifies trace and space, open or shorted nets, aspect ratio, and other parameters
of your design. It's used to prevent potential errors in the production process by identifying them
in the design phase.

### PCB Surface Finish

There are numerous printed circuit board surface finishes, including ENIG, HASL (Tin-lead or
lead-free), Immersion Silver, ENEPIG, and so forth. Well Done has rich experience assisting
customers in choosing the correct surface finish solution.

### DXF to Gerber Files

Gerber files are generally more accurate than DXF files since they are meant for machine-readable
output. You can use a variety of software programs to convert DXF to Gerbers. Some of the most
popular programs include: Gerbv, Adobe Illustrator, CorelDRAW.

### High Density Surface Mount

High Density Surface Mount Technology (HD-SMT) uses very densely packed arrays of small, closely
spaced pads. This enables significantly higher component density than traditional surface-mount.

You can benefit from our professional printed circuit board design process from pcb layout to [pcb
stack-up][74] and [creating PCB schematic design][75]. When the project is beginning, our pcb design
engineers will build your pcb engineering by [pcb design software][76]. We'll use popular programs
like Altium Designer,KiCAD and more.
[ Check Details ][77]

### PCB Repair

Common pcb repair engineering includes component rework, surface mount pads, solder mask repair,
de-solder and relayout of boards. Furthermore,you can request making changes to fix an existing
design flaw. Just send your circuit board to us, our technicians will work quickly and efficiently
to get it repaired.
[ Check Details ][78]

## PCB Reverse Engineering Procedures

#1 - ICs Unlock (Optional)
Extract the program from Board 25%
#2 - PCB Reverse Engineering
Get gerber file & BOM list, create layout and generate a schematic 50%
#3 - Prototype PCB Fabrication
Building and producing the pcb sample with schematic 75%
#4 - PCB Functional Testing
Inspect the performance of the new board, troubleshoot issues, and fix incompatibilities before the
mass production 100%

## What We Need Before Quoting a PCB Reverse Engineering Project

For a reliable quote, please share board photos, board dimensions, layer count if known,
component-side images, any available firmware or part markings, and the expected output files. For
multilayer PCBs, destructive layer-by-layer analysis may be required when internal traces, blind
vias, buried vias, or controlled impedance structures cannot be confirmed from the outside.

───────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────
Input from customer│Engineering review                          │Possible deliverables              
───────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────
Physical PCB sample│Layer count, stackup, trace routing,        │PCB layout, Gerber, drill file,    
                   │component placement                         │netlist                            
───────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────
Board photos and   │IC identification, passive values, connector│BOM, schematic notes, replacement  
markings           │mapping                                     │suggestions                        
───────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────
Known failure      │Power, signal, and test-point               │Repair guidance, test report,      
symptoms           │troubleshooting                             │redesign advice                    
───────────────────┴────────────────────────────────────────────┴───────────────────────────────────

## Value-Added Services

Looking for more service about PCB engineering? You can benefit from our wide range of services as
below. And our experts will ensure no delays due to quality or errors while working on your project.

### PCB Stackup Design

When designing a PCB stackup, we can help our customers guide, create or verify the stackup. They
are suitable for all impedance control requirements for single-ended, differential pair, coplanar
waveguide and other technologies.

### controlled impedance PCB

Due to the growing application of low-impedance circuits, low-impedance modeling has become an
important aspect of circuit design. If you have mpedance-controlled requirements, we can help you
for controlled impedance modeling.

### Design Rule Checking

Design Rule Check verifies trace and space, open or shorted nets, aspect ratio, and other parameters
of your design. It's used to prevent potential errors in the production process by identifying them
in the design phase.

### PCB Surface Finish

There are numerous printed circuit board surface finishes, including ENIG, HASL (Tin-lead or
lead-free), Immersion Silver, ENEPIG, and so forth. Well Done has rich experience assisting
customers in choosing the correct surface finish solution.

### DXF to Gerber Files

Gerber files are generally more accurate than DXF files since they are meant for machine-readable
output. You can use a variety of software programs to convert DXF to Gerbers. Some of the most
popular programs include: Gerbv, Adobe Illustrator, CorelDRAW.

### High Density Surface Mount

High Density Surface Mount Technology (HD-SMT) uses very densely packed arrays of small, closely
spaced pads. This enables significantly higher component density than traditional surface-mount.

## About Well Done

Founded in 2008, Well Done PCB Limited is a circuit board engineering company based in China. We
provides excellent PCB engineering services by combining innovative solutions with high standard. We
are dedicated to realize electronic product reduction and clone services for everyone. No matter how
difficult your PCB project is, we can tailor and customize it for you.

2008

Well Done Technology was founded by Xia and Lee in 2008, is a leading PCB reverse engineering firm
in China. We focused on PCB cloning, reverse engineering, and chips unlock services.

2012

#### Team Expanding

By 2012, our team expanded to over 50 members, including 5 senior technicians. To meet the client
demands, we made a strategic shift to prioritize reverse engineering as our core business.

2017

#### Global Business

In 2017, we successfully penetrated global markets, with over 50% of clients originating from
international regions. We had completed more than 1,000 PCB reverse-engineering projects.

2022

#### Tech Upgrade

In 2022, we launched the expansion of our laboratory base and the comprehensive upgrade of high-tech
electronic equipment, aiming to improve the efficiency of our service to customers.

**Satchitanand Group** is operational **since 1992** and has **Eight manufacturing facilities**
based at **Bangalore (1992), Chennai (2007), Noida (2012), Pune (2014), Gurgaon (2016), Hyderabad
(2018), Moshi – Pune (2019), Bommasandra – Bangalore (2020)** to manufacture **SMT Laser Cut
Stencils, Wave Solder Pallets, Jigs & Fixtures and CNC Machine Components**.

This setup is developed inline with the policy of the Group to provide prompt service by closely
working with geographic proximity with the customers. The **all India presence** of Satchitanand
Group represent its **long term commitment** and **wide reach **to **serve** its **customers**.

[ Milestone ][14]

### Our Vision

To continuously innovate and be customer centric manufactures of top quality precision products

### Our Mission

Serving Indian industry through indigenisation and innovation

### Our Values

Integrity, Innovation, Empathy, Achievement

### Our Purpose

Promoting Excellence, Committed to fulfilling Ethical standards and contributing great value to our
customers by maximum capacity utilization of cutting edge technology and empowering every member of
the organization.

### Quality Policy

SPTC is committed to satisfy customers, by supply of quality products at optimum cost and on time
delivery through continual improvement and reviewing the effectiveness of quality management system,
quality policy and quality objectives.

## About Us

We are a minority, women owned, ISO certified supplier, dedicated to the design of machinery for the
automation of manufacturing processes. We offer design and engineering services, hardware selection,
implementation of control systems, support for starting machinery, commissioning, and support in
control systems.

[LEARN MORE][27]

### Mission

SMT Automation wants total customer satisfaction by offering designs that meet customer
specifications, as well as providing control engineering and automation services with optimum
delivery and execution times.

### Vision

SMT Automation wants to be one of the best companies to provide support and services in control and
automation systems. At the same time, we want to be a development platform for your team, customers
and suppliers.

### Values

The core values are the building blocks for our company and everyone involved in it. Using values
everyday, the SMT Automation team is working towards the same goals and objectives.

Accountability

Commitment

Teamwork

 

Innovation

Trust

### Sustainability Statement

At SMTAutomation, we are committed to integrating eco-friendly practices and efficient resource use
into every project. Our automation solutions help clients reduce energy consumption and waste, while
our responsible outsourcing division ensures ethical labor practices and community impact.
Innovation drives us to continuously improve, using cutting-edge technologies that enhance
productivity and support environmental stewardship. We believe in building a future where industry
and sustainability go hand in hand.

## I.C.T Smart Line Solution

[I.C.T SMT Machine Line SMT Production Line]

Complete **SMT machine line Solution** for ICT. Our lineup includes **SMT Stencil Printers**, **Pick
and Place Machines**, **Reflow Ovens**, **AOI Machines**, **SPI Machines**, **PCB Loaders**, and
more. These tools are meticulously chosen to enhance efficiency and precision in your manufacturing
process.

[I.C.T DIP Machine Line]

Comprehensive DIP Solution for ICT. Our lineup includes essential equipment such as **Automatic
Insertion Machines**, **Selective Solder Machines**, ** DIP AOI Machines**, **X-ray machines**,
**ICT Test Machines**, and more. Whether you're looking to improve through-hole soldering, quality
inspection, or testing processes, our solutions are designed to meet your needs.

[I.C.T Conformal Coating Line For Double Sides PCBA]

Showcasing our comprehensive **Conformal Coating Line Solution** for ICT. Our solution includes a
**conformal coating machine**,**glue curing oven**, **Coating AOI Machine**, and features a return
loop. This line is capable of coating both sides of PCBs efficiently. For more details, feel free to
reach out to us.

seamlessly integrating advanced microelectronics.

consumer electronics, and beyond. Its smooth and efficient operation helps create small,
high-performance electronic systems, promoting innovation and advancing technology in different
fields.”

Tap for details ↻

### Surface Mounting Technology (SMT) Stencils

assembly.

## Photoplotting

Tap for details ↻

generation.

## WHY CHOOSE STV GROUP?

Solutions engineered for demanding industrial lines.

electronics & SMT, and architectural & industrial glass.

entities across several countries. Our legacy is built on precision, repeatability, and long‑term

### 科學與美學的邂逅

VITALAGE ([日間醫療中心牌照
DP000301) ][25]為每位客人度身訂造一套具有科學論證的個人化醫學美容療程，治療進程貼合客人的生活狀況及

每位客人共創璀璨人生！

 

VITALAGE ([Day Procedure Centre DP000301)][26][ ][27]provides clinically-proven medical aesthetics
treatments that are personalized and delivered with genuine love and care. To achieve optimal
results while maintaining the highest quality and safety standards, VITALAGE treatment programs are
designed and fine-tuned based on the client’s individual lifestyle and needs. As a photographic
memoire of the client’s beauty evolution, “before & after” photos will be taken for record, which,
along with all other patient information, are kept private and strictly confidential. VITALAGE is
committed to quality and service from heart.
